name: Glitch Image
description: Square image rendered on a p5 canvas with a continuous digital glitch: scanning bright line, horizontal slice shifts, RGB channel offsets and scattered fragment blocks.
contents: Square cropped image canvas centered in a full-height dark frame
Loading label shown until the image is ready
behavior: Image is center-cropped to a square and drawn on a p5 canvas
Each frame applies a moving flow line, random row shifts, RGB channel displacement and scattered rectangle copies
Random short pauses show the clean image
editableByProps: Intensity through line, shift and fragment counts

needsCodeEdit.change: Glitch ranges such as RGB offset distance
Pause frequency and duration of clean frames

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Image must allow cross-origin loading for pixel access
